rules.instruction: When the description says that several checks are carried out one after another on separate components, and that a later joint step follows only if every check succeeds, while a failed check sends the work back to be redone: Model one exclusive decision gateway after the last check and before the joint step. Route one branch, labelled with the condition that all checks passed, to the joint step. Route the other branch, labelled with the failure condition, to a rework task that loops back to the building step the description names. Do not connect the joint step directly from the checks, and do not omit the gateway.
rules.situation: the description says that several checks are carried out one after another on separate components, and that a later joint step follows only if every check succeeds, while a failed check sends the work back to be redone

rules.instruction: When the description states that the actor gives or hands over items to another party, and that party then performs work on those items before the process continues: Model the hand-over as its own manual task placed after the step that precedes it and before the task in which the other party performs the work. Connect the preceding task to the hand-over task and the hand-over task to the work task with sequence flows.
